requirements.text: The system should allow customers to book appointments online at any time while still accommodating phone bookings.
Appointment reminders should be sent via both SMS and email, one day before and one hour before the appointment.
The system should display the availability of each barber at specific times, allowing customers to choose their preferred barber.
Each barber should have the ability to update their own availability in the system.
The system must integrate seamlessly with the current workflow to avoid disruptions.
